findings.rationale: A Core feature implementations target may depend only on interfaces.
findings.ruleStatement: An implementations target (Presentation, `<Feature>Implementations`) may depend only on interface targets, plus SharedImplementations in Core. Never on another implementation, and never on a test doubles target.

findings.fix:
Wrap it in `#if canImport(UIKit)`.
Or move the code.
100% of 50, really: yes
findings.message: Unconditional `import UIKit` in 'Presentation' can't be built on Linux
findings.rationale: Packages build and test on Linux CI. UI frameworks and Apple-only system frameworks live in the Xcode projects (UI, Infrastructure, the composition root), which is why those aren't packages. An allowlist fails closed: a framework nobody thought of is caught too.
findings.ruleStatement: A Swift package may unconditionally import only declared first-party modules and system modules that exist on Linux: Dispatch, Foundation, FoundationEssentials, Observation, RegexBuilder, Swift, Synchronization, Testing, XCTest. Any other import must sit inside `#if canImport(Module)`.
